reviews.text:
The pet sitters are very nice!
Thanks to the care of the owner!
If we need hotel accommodation again, we will definitely choose them!

We took our little one for a 1-week stay and care.
They welcome their guests with extraordinary flexibility and kindness. They are available both online and by phone. They give a preliminary quote. Their attitude is professional. In order to provide the most appropriate care possible, they ask everything about the animal. If necessary, they also undertake extra care and medication.
Everything was fine, as always, I recommend!

A very friendly, nice place, where they pay maximum attention to the animals. You can see from the team that they do their job with love. We have only positive experiences with them. I can only recommend the place! :)
You are very kind and professional! Although the price may seem high, in return your pets are in safe hands.

Our two dwarf bunnies spent several weeks here in the summer, and we were very satisfied :)
There was a little misunderstanding about the billing, but the first question that came up was recalculated and clarified.
And they took loving care of Bunnies, Bodza and Dixi :)

We bought our little jungle here and they provided us with all the necessary supplies and information. Since then we have been there several times, sometimes for food, sometimes for boarding. We are extremely satisfied, they are very kind, and you can feel that they really love animals.

It was the first time we couldn't leave our bunny with a family member. The booking process was very smooth and everyone in the shop was very nice. 😊 We were able to bring our own equipment to the rented cage, we got a picture every day and they even helped us with trimming the claws. There was no problem getting home either, we will use the Pet Hotel again. 🩷
Great place for pets, friendly and helpful staff, we were satisfied with everything.

This was the first time we took our bunny here. It was taken very good care of during our absence, we asked for and received photos, which we were always very happy about. If we ever have a situation like this again, where we travel and can't take care of our bunny, we will take it here.

Thank you very much on behalf of the two dogs, Spotted and Small, for the loving care.
We enjoyed the hospitality of the pet hotel during our vacation.
We recommend it to everyone with all our hearts.
Dia and Magdi ♥️

Our hedgehog Szotyi was in the guesthouse for the second time and we didn't regret it. He got everything he needed, the staff are very kind and helpful, we will take him here from now on. Thank you for everything❤️❤️

Thank you very much for keeping our furry and feathered family members safe while we were on vacation. I can only recommend them to everyone ❤️❤️❤️❤️ it's exactly the same this year ❤️ we had a completely peaceful vacation ❤️❤️❤️ We still feel that way today ❤️❤️❤️ Oreo, Lilibogyó and Kormi partied there on New Year's Eve 😄😄😄❤️❤️❤️
Our animals spent another week there, we were still satisfied with their care ❤️❤️❤️
They were very kind, they welcomed our bunny within a day and took care of it while we were on vacation.👍

We found everything in order when we arrived to pick up our bunny. Everything was as we asked, and Pami even helped with a butt wipe, which we didn't ask for anyway and therefore they didn't ask for anything in return. I am completely satisfied with the pet hotel! We will bring our beloved bunny here again!

We have already contacted you several times about the accommodation of our tortoise, Masni. We are very satisfied, we bring Masni here with joy and peace of mind, because we know that you have paid attention to him and that he receives the best care, and in addition to your kindness, we are grateful for your flexibility, reliability and love for animals! ♥️♥️♥️♥️
It was a good feeling to travel knowing that our hedgehog was safe and being looked after. I received a picture of him every day (he seemed to be doing well).

My hedgehog was in absolutely reliable, caring hands at your place. Although GeorgeFosh originally comes from Varjúvölgyi, it's great that there is a boarding house because I can't imagine entrusting him to anyone else. I got a very happy little hedgehog back, spayed, dewormed, and with his nails trimmed, so I'm very grateful to you, and if I could, I would give it 6 stars.
They took great care of the bunny. They accommodated its needs, and we got back a healthy and curious little pet.
Very kind, helpful staff, flexible attitude, we were completely satisfied. Our hedgehog also had a good time 😊 …
Nice staff. Fast and flexible.
Everything was fine. Our hamster felt good.

This is our first time here, we were looking for a place for our family pet while we were on vacation. He was welcomed with great love, we got a fresh picture of him every day, so we always knew he was being taken care of and was doing well.

Our golden hamster named Guszti spent his days in the guesthouse with full care while we were away. He grew a lot, he was treated well, for sure. 😄The other pet sitters gave each other the doorknob, so this also proves that many agree with me that they leave their little pets in good hands until they can't be with them. We recommend the Hamster Village to everyone who wants a small pet, or who has one but doesn't know where to put it when they travel. I have already given the address to several of my friends.
In the attached picture, on the way home🙂

If I could give it more stars I would ☺️ our two guinea pigs "vacated" here for a week, Pufi and Zizi. It's obvious that they really love animals ❤️ we also received advice and filled up our guinea pig food supplies at home before leaving. We will probably bring the pigs here next summer while we go on vacation.
My zebra finches stayed with you for over a week, they were very well looked after, they even received a special little bowl of seeds from you. Thank you very much for your care.
We were the first guests with 3 little canaries, we will come again! Professional team, it was a great relief to know that our birds were safe. Thank you for that 🐤🐤🐤

This is the first time I left my dwarf rabbit, Coconut, who spent a week here, alone. The photos I received every day reassured me that he was in the best hands, that he was being watched and cared for. When he got home, he was the same inquisitive, curious bunny he was before we took him, with no signs of stress or fear. Thank you for everything!

They have taken care of my dwarf rabbit several times. We have been satisfied every time. They handed over the rabbit and the cage nicely and cleanly.
They are kind and helpful.
I will choose them again next time if I need to take care of my rabbit.

We entrusted our 2 bunnies to the Pet Hotel for 12 days.
They felt very comfortable, they couldn't stand the change. The girls are nice, a really good solution if you don't know who to entrust your pet to. We also received a photo of them. I can only recommend it.
I am very satisfied! :) Thank you for taking care of our piglets while we were on vacation.

Our beloved hamster was released in a very good environment. He must have felt good. 🙂
Thank you for your concern. 🙂

They are very kind, the bunny felt good, arrived home healthy, well-groomed, calmly and actively occupied her home again. This is very important to me! The communication contacts could be improved a bit, because it is not clear where to indicate needs and requests. Especially if we want to write an email, for example from abroad. Thank you very much for your care!

Our hedgehog spent 2 weeks at the hotel, everything was fine, we received the cage back nicely cleaned, and they even descaled its water bowl, which was more than I expected. I would definitely recommend the hotel to everyone.
I can recommend it to everyone, our two bunnies spent our vacation there, everything was perfect, everyone was very nice😊
They've been taking care of our turtle here for years while we're on vacation, and everything has always been in great order.
They are very kind and attentive to the little pets

Gyros is always in a great place with you. He has already spent several holidays with you, and we have trusted you with peace of mind every time. We are very happy that we found you, and we have already recommended you to others with a good heart. 🐢 …

We highly recommend this truly loving, caring, wholehearted “team” to all owners. Our bunny was in the best hands.
Expertise/reliability = calm owner, calm pet ❤️
❤️❤️endless thanks
Pinike was with her Kind Caretakers again and for a longer period
Great!! She also learned about picking berries😀 thanks❤️❤️❤️❤️

We left our bunny in very good hands. It was obvious from the people working there that they are pet-loving people. We will take him to them again in the future if we need him to be kept and cared for.😁 …
Everything was fine again. Our piglets were treated well.

"I was a bit nervous about leaving my rabbit ‘ Cuki’ for three days, but this place was amazing. He settled in perfectly and clearly enjoyed his stay. It's so hard to find a spot that knows how to care for bunnies properly—will definitely use them again! Thank you for taking such good care of him.
"A five-star stay!!" Highly recommend for small pets!"

I am writing this review as a frustrated and disappointed owner.

Our bunny, Rafi, spent a few days here, but upon his return home, we felt that the care he received was far below what we expected.

Rafi was shy and confused, which was unusual for him. We received his house and his own mat back soaked in urine, which had been turned upside down. His litter tray was full of hay, which he always eats, not uses as litter. There was a patch of hair missing from his nose, and after returning home, he started sneezing, which had never happened to him before.

We received photos every day during his stay, but these were only close-ups, so we could not see the entire cage or the conditions under which he was kept. As owners, this was not reassuring.

Update on owner response: Thank you for responding to my review. Of course, I accept that you see what happened differently, but this does not change what we experienced with our own bunny and the equipment we received back. My assessment is not born of malice, but reflects our own experience. I regret that your response was in several points more sarcastic than sympathetic towards a disappointed owner.

Based on our own experience, we would not trust Rafi with you again, so we cannot recommend this place.
My bunny enjoyed the comfort of the cool hotel for the second summer!

The caretakers are kind, helpful, they paid attention to our bunny's needs, he received good care and, most importantly, he did not suffer from the change of environment either mentally or physically. We will definitely use their services again! I recommend them!

The girls took care of our piglets for 2 weeks. They are kind, helpful, and they clearly care about the little fur babies :). Sometimes we even asked about our piglets by phone, the girls always called us back and we received a reassuring report :). The piglets felt good (every day we received pictures of them by email, they were petted, their eyes were calm), we received them back in perfect health. I can only recommend their hotel and beauty services to anyone.

5-month-old bunny Ropi stayed at the guesthouse for a week, we were worried about how he would handle this period, but there was no problem, as soon as we got home, he immediately relaxed and ran around, jumping around the house, the staff was also very kind, you can tell from the bunny that he was in a good place, they treated him well, we will definitely be back :)
I leave my agama there with confidence every time, he receives excellent care and a lot of care. 🥰 Thank you very much! …
Our guinea pigs were treated well at the pet boarding house. Whenever we go into the store, the salespeople are always helpful, kind, and know their stuff.
Everyone is very kind, they welcome the pets with great love. Our piglets have vacationed here many times, we leave them with a calm heart, because we know they are in good hands. 😊 …

Despite making an appointment by phone, we were not served on site. We wanted to buy a female finch, which we had announced in advance, but the seller told us on site that they only sell finches in pairs. Moreover, they would have sold them for more than the price listed online.
It was a great help to have our guinea pigs in such a good place during our trip!
We brought our guinea pigs here for 5 days. We received all the information and a conscientious, kind team took care of Molly and Mimi. Thank you! We will be back!
Oh, that's good! :)
They take great care of my pet every time, I get a calm, healthy little one back!!
Dear

I wholeheartedly recommend the Pet Hotel to anyone looking for a safe and loving place for their little pet. Taking care of our bunny Dorka was a completely reassuring experience for us.
The attention, care and true love for animals was palpable. Dorka came home calm and balanced, which is the biggest feedback for us that she was in good hands.
We will definitely be back and we wholeheartedly recommend it to other owners! 🐰💖
Very helpful, professional shop. We bought Mogyi the hammock here and also used the hotel service. They are flexible, kind, they solve everything. 5*
They were very kind and helpful with everything. The animals are kept in good conditions and the products are great.

Left my hamster in their care multiple times already, 2 and 3 weeks at a time. Only had to bring the hamster with the food, cage was already provided (300ft extra per day which is very fair price). I also got the photo update in mid of my holiday, I was glad to see he was in good care! The onboarding as well as picking up my pet was very simple and quick, no hassle. I like the idea that I can either pay up front or after the boarding. Also one of the ladies at the shop speaks English which was super helpful! The ladies working there are very kind and do seem to remember me and my little guy. Didn't have any issues and the hamster was always returned in good health and well. I am glad I have one place that I can trust with my little fella while I am away, I will be using this service in the future as well!

My bunny Mogyi stayed at the guesthouse for 5 days at Christmas. We were very satisfied, we asked for a photo of him every day, which was very reassuring to see that he was doing well, we not only brought his own food, but also his own color, because my bunny is very picky, plus his own litter tray, since he is a house bunny, so he needs a bigger toilet, and I didn't want foreign smells to disturb the cleanliness of his room. The drop-off and pick-up went very quickly, and the people working there were super nice and cute, the little lady said that she stroked my bunny a lot, because he was very well behaved and a little nice while taking care of him, so he also got extra cuddles 🙂 and this is an extra good feeling for an owner's heart, that they took such loving care of their little pet.
I highly recommend the guesthouse, we will use it again if we need it again. Thank you for taking care of Mogyikám.
Kind, helpful team, accurate photos of our bunny, thank you!
They have been taking care of my bunny for years, and everything always goes well. They are very fast, prepared even in a holiday rush.

Our little hamster spent 6 days at the pet hotel over Christmas. He was warmly welcomed, and it was evident how much he felt at home there, that when we brought him home, he wasn't even scratched, everything was the same as before.
Thank you for taking care of him! :)

They always take good care of our little one when we bring them to the guesthouse, and we also bought our hamster from them. They were very helpful, we got a lot of useful information at the beginning, and we were always able to buy super quality equipment, food, etc. I can only recommend this place :)
The girls are very kind and helpful, our bunny had a great place while we were on vacation. :-)
I've left my hedgehog with them several times when I had to travel, they are very fair, I'd be happy to entrust Lionel to them anytime. :)

Our 2 goldfinches spent 13 days here, in their own terrarium. We got a photo of them at halftime.
The girls were nice, we will definitely bring them here next time💜 …

Very nice place, nice and helpful staff.
I've been here several times and always had a positive experience.
The staff at the guesthouse were kind, they took care of my bunny in a clean environment and sent me some really cool photos.

They were kind and took care of my little wave. They also sent me a photo of him as agreed. Everything went smoothly and quickly. The next time I travel, Rodrigó will definitely come here.
Endre
Our pet was taken care of with maximum attention and care. Professional team. Thank you and we recommend.

I can only recommend the pet hotel. They took great care of my two guinea pigs. They even called me from abroad because my two little pigs were a little depressed. We discussed what would be best for them. At first they were in two separate cages because I asked for it, but then they felt better when they were together. Thank you for taking care of them!
Best place. Attentive, kind. We always bring our bunny to you. 🩷🐰 …

We left our chameleon Rezső at the pet hotel during our vacation. We have been to the store several times and bought the chameleon there. We really like the place and the people who work there. There was no question for a minute that we would leave the chameleon with them during our vacation, because the animal receives almost as good care there as at home. We will entrust Rezső to their care next time, and we may even bring our rabbit and parrot with us. 😂
Excellent service, we are always completely satisfied with them.
The ladies who take care of the pets were nice and apparently our bunny also felt good in the "hotel" during the almost week.
Thank you ;)
Extremely friendly, truly dedicated little team. They are reliable and helpful. They take very kind and competent care of the little pets.
A very decent, reliable business.
They are very kind. We appreciate their flexibility, our bunny has been vacationing there for years.
They took good care of my bearded dragon while I was abroad. Information provided on their website is accurate. I can wholeheartedly recommend the place.
Thanks :)
Thank you!

This was our first time using the hotel's services. Our guinea pigs spent 10 days here while we were on vacation. We received them back safe and sound. Booking an appointment, handover and collection went smoothly.
We will come again.
But thank you, dear!
They are very kind and we were able to keep our little bunny safe and sound while we were on vacation! I recommend it to everyone!
We have left our hedgehog at the pet boarding house several times, everything has been fine so far. The owners are very helpful and kind.
As long as Sanyika is alive, I will always bring her here on vacation! :)
They kindly took care of our hamster, and his little "apartment" was spotlessly clean when we got it back.
They are very kind and helpful. I will definitely choose them again! Thank you for taking care of my bunny ❤️
We have taken a bunny several times. They are helpful and kind in everything, and it is in an easily accessible location for us.
A very friendly, animal-loving, caring place. We have been taking our bunny Folthy to the guesthouse for many years and they always take great care of him with love and attention🤎! …

I highly recommend the Pet Hotel! They are attentive, patient, flexible and helpful and last but not least, they are prepared!
Thank you very much!

I can only recommend them. It is very difficult to entrust a pet, which is a family member, to someone. They were fair, partners in everything, and my secret concern was whether it would be in a good place when I got it back. They are kind, caring. Now I always take it there if I can't take my dog ​​with me.
Very pleased with the service, we left our hamster for 20 days and they took care of him in a very well manner
They took care of our bunny here for 9 days, they were very kind and shared a lot of important information about keeping rabbits that we had never heard from anyone before.
Very nice place. We knew our favorites were in a good place.
I was very satisfied with the care of the bunny☺️I can only recommend it. Thank you very much☺️.

Rózika the parrot felt very comfortable here for a week, unfortunately there was no opportunity for a flight. I hope that if more parrots become guests, they will release the birds later. Mine will go back to its cage by itself.
Everything was fine, thank you!
We would like to thank you on behalf of our parrot Bunsi and Mortimer. They will definitely be going to your boarding house, we knew they were safe and Bunsi came home nicely😊 …
Great, friendly, professional team, I can only recommend them to anyone!

Thank you for taking care of the naughty bunny!

The child was very happy with the daily pictures.
The bunny was taken over relatively quickly after thorough questions. The return was also with essential information.
The nails were neatly cut.

I took my bunny, Lajos, to the hotel for the first time. I brought home a balanced, happy bunny.
Thank you for being there!

This is the first time we have used the pet hotel service for our chameleon and we are very satisfied. The registration process was easy and everything went smoothly. All the employees in the store were very kind and helpful. We have bought pet animals from here for our chameleon before. If we need to take care of our animal again next time, we will definitely take it here. Thank you!
Our gecko enjoyed the hospitality of the Pet Hotel for 3 weeks. He was well taken care of during this time, we are very satisfied with their service. If the need arises, we will bring him here again.
Caring, knowledgeable professionals, advice.
Everything was fine, the staff were kind and helpful, there were no problems with the piglets, they came home healthy.

I highly recommend the Pet Hotel! 🐾
My chinchilla spent a whole week here while we were on vacation, and I am extremely satisfied with the service. They carefully fed her, kept her place clean, and obviously paid attention to her needs. It was a special pleasure for me that we received a photo of her every day, so we could rest easy knowing that she was in good hands.

This is not the first time we have been here: we have previously accommodated my Mongolian gerbils in this guesthouse, and they received the same professional and loving treatment.

Such a conscientious, pet-friendly place is rare – I can only recommend it to anyone who wants to know their pet is safe while they are away! 💚
Expertise. Accuracy. Precision. Kindness.
Pets in expert hands
Everything was perfect. I can only recommend it to everyone.

Pami always comes home cheerful, which is surprising to me because she doesn't like strange people and places. She is much friendlier than she used to be. And yet I also take care of her a lot. I am 100% satisfied with the Pension. The employees are very kind and sweet.
It wasn't the first time Boni the bunny was here, and probably not the last :-) If you're looking for a reliable, professional, nice place for your bunnies.... only them! :-)
Super nice, professional service!
Our bunnies always go to their wellness center, we love them so much! 😁 They are reliable, I can only say positive things about them. …
Thank you for your care, our little cockatiel didn't complain that he was missing anything 👍 …
Kind, expert service, we love it

We are returning with our bunny because we want to keep it safe while we are on vacation. Registration is recommended! You can also ask for extras for the care, such as a photo or claw trimming per day. The fur should also be combed because when we got it back, we looked at the rabbit and it was shedding. Correct and kind service.
Everything was great, we got what we expected. Nice, friendly place, we will take our bunny there next time!

Kind, helpful staff. I can only recommend them!!! They have been taking care of our Gombócs for years, they have acted with the utmost care in every situation! Special thanks for the flexibility shown in the booking! 🐇 …
Péter Nyúl is always very nice to you and it's a big help that he always comes home clean :)

They are kind and attentive to the animals.
We take our bunny to them regularly

We regularly keep our Negro bunny safe at the Pet Hotel when we have to travel for several days and cannot take him with us.
What we also like about them is that they also have a beauty salon (if required, we can also trim his nails during this time).
I can only recommend the nice, cheerful, family-friendly pet hotel :)
This is the third time we have left our two little hairless pigs at the Pet Hotel, and everything went very smoothly and quickly. Thank you for your help and care!

Competent professional help.
I recommend

Our bunny was here for two weeks. We received photos of him, so we could see that he was doing well. We were also satisfied with everything. The delivery/receipt was done quickly, we almost didn't have to wait. We will come again!

I've been bringing my bunny here for 4 years now when I travel, he's in good hands in winter and summer and he always comes home from the boarding house in a good mood and healthy, I can only recommend him! :)

We would like to thank the pet hotel/"babysitters" :-) for taking care of our two bad-tempered guinea pigs for 11 days.
We brought them home again in a very nice, well-groomed condition.
We have used this type of service several times and have always been satisfied; in fact, our guinea pigs, when we bring them, already sniff around with interest because they know the place, which makes them feel safe. So we can leave them at the guesthouse with peace of mind during our trips, because we know they are in a great location.
They were kind and professional. Thank you :)

The hotel's animal caretakers are very kind, they pay great attention to each animal, they love them very much, and they provide the owners with good and professional advice. We thank them and recommend them to everyone who doesn't know where to take their pet when traveling.
Very kind, helpful staff even on the last day of the year.
Very nice employees, my pets were in good hands with them. :)

The people working here are very kind and know how to take care of animals. Our little pets (two hamsters) were safe and we think (based on the pictures) they had a great time. We will bring them here again🥰 …
Thank you very much!
Our hamster has been to his birthplace for the third time while we were away. He arrived home in great condition. Thank you for taking care of him!
Your positive review is very appreciated, thank you very much!

I came away with mixed feelings. I don't know what the reasons behind what I experienced could be. First, they gave my bunny another bowl instead of his water bowl, and both were completely dry, as if they hadn't had water in them for a long time. But the bigger problem was that they ran out of litter from under him, which he could use to pee in, so they took it out and instead let him pee on his little rug and in his cage wherever he could. The rug is full of pee stains, so the poor thing could have used that for days. They could have said they would put litter underneath and I would have paid for it. Mircsu was tense, a little confused, he wasn't in a good mental state when I brought him, but that could also be because he has a hard time making friends with new people/situations, so I wouldn't blame him for that. I don't think this pet hotel was a good choice. The place itself seems clean and tidy, the service is nice, but I feel like this litter and water bowl thing were out of order.

Evgeny Anyegin, who spent 2 months with you this time, has returned to us in great shape again, to soon move to Austria for half a year. He will visit you again in the spring, so that while we are on vacation, he can enjoy wellness with you😁thank you for always taking professional care of him🙏 …

We were very satisfied with both the service and the attitude of the staff. Our little parrot spent his days there happily... thank you to the caring team. We would only entrust our little pet to them in the future.

They are a wonderful team, I can only praise them. One of my two parrots accidentally escaped while feeding. It flew 10 km. Thanks to the amazing work of the workers, the bird was born in two days. I would like to thank them for making this miracle happen!
They are very kind and helpful, I can only recommend them.

My little son's budgie spent more than a month at the Pet Hotel. Both the move-in and the goodbye were kind and smooth, the love for animals and the dedication to their work were clearly visible from all the employees. Ramirez came home very balanced, clean and healthy, it was clear that everything was fine with him during the time he spent there. He was already "telling" a lot in the car, and his beak hasn't stopped growing since :)
